description: Plain numbered text of one section, regulation, article or schedule paragraph, as it stands today or on a past date, with amendment and commencement notes. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

date.description: Point in time, YYYY-MM-DD (default: current revised text)

provision.description: Path such as section/3, regulation/2, article/5 or schedule/1/paragraph/4

type.description: Legislation type code (ukpga, uksi, asp, ssi, wsi, nisr…; see types)

year.description: Year (or regnal year for pre-1963, e.g. Eliz2/10-11)

name: uk-legislation__provision
title: UK Legislation: Provision text
